name: Wildcard: opening a Case of Fortune hands out all twenty scrolls and uses up one case (#8033)
contract: Case of Fortune 1278049 holds twenty guaranteed scrolls, Scroll of Fortune I-XX: Abilities 97913-97932, but the
3.3.5a loot window shows at most 18 slots (MAX_NR_LOOT_ITEMS). Scrolls XIX and XX could never be taken, so the
loot never finished: the case stayed in the bags, and the rest of a stack kept the half-looted loot (#8033, #9039).
Expected: each open of a stacked case stores all twenty scrolls, uses up exactly one case and sends one item loot
release, so a second open of the same stack works the same way.

steps.label: A second bag for the scrolls
SETUP the hero holds a stack of two cases
SETUP no item loot release has been sent yet
CONTRACT (#8033) one case of the stack is used up
CONTRACT (#8033) Scroll of Fortune I is handed out
CONTRACT (#8033) Scroll of Fortune XVIII is handed out
CONTRACT (#8033) Scroll of Fortune XIX is handed out
CONTRACT (#8033) Scroll of Fortune XX is handed out
CONTRACT (#8033) the client was told to leave the looting state
Open the second case of the stack
CONTRACT (#9039) the second case is used up
CONTRACT (#9039) the second case hands out Scroll of Fortune I again
CONTRACT (#9039) the second case hands out Scroll of Fortune XX again
CONTRACT (#9039) each open sends one item loot release
